item.title: Report: Alabama moving Bryan Ellis to QB coach
item.description: Alabama will have a familiar face coaching its new starting quarterback next season. item.title: What Devan Thompkins will bring to the Alabama defense
item.description: Devan Thompkins is joining the Crimson Tide after transferring from USC. Thompkins spent four years with the Trojans. He took a redshirt after his freshman season, ultimately leaving him with one year of eligibility. He will be spending his last year of college football with the Tide.
